name: Raphael
source:
He's a courtier who's been in the service of the late King for a long time and takes care of treasury business nowadays. Additionally, he's been assigned to be the protagonist's personal servant.
Raphael seems to be a soothing personality who never loses his temper, even when placed into the position of chasing Prince Nazir all day to get him to attend his duties.
